items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: Bobby Hackett asked me to come on the road with him to a place named Dunfy’s.

ctx.x: Is that right and you’re playing behind these people?

I had a good ear. I mean I knew whether a chord was a minor chord or a major chord without having to be told but it was at this point that I started getting into the text and was learning to read and figuring out changes, learning what chord symbols, what they really meant and what all that fruit salad, you know the plus eleven and all that stuff hanging off, dangling off the end of a chord meant and what to do with it. And I stayed there about a year and a half and Bobby Hackett asked me to come on the road with…
